name: The Sunken Railways
desc:
The Sunken Railways is a gloomy sub-location of [Second Layer/New Kyrsa](location:new_kyrsa). It is where one of the five Obelisks required to access where the [Scion of Ethiron](entity:scion_of_ethiron) boss fight is located. Its most notable feature is its bottom floor, containing a Kyrsan Obelisk, two railways with trains on them, and there may be a Kyrsan Medallions chest spawn.

The top floor mostly does not have anything important, but does contain an additional Kyrsan Medallions chest and many spawns for Kyrsgarde Crawler’s after the Obelisk is activated.
